narrative: He is standing in the door, not in the dance. The stage is Kemp's. Phillips has the cittern. A tabor boy is at the side, unnamed, not a face to remember. Arthur is in a borrowed kirtle. Sam is low, after the shoes. The cittern is driven hard. The slippers are yellow, Turkish, enormous. Kemp is wet through.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Had the stage, wet through, in the yellow slippers.

entities.name: Arthur Meeks
entities.context: Was the scold in the borrowed kirtle.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Was the prentice who stole the shoes.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood in the door, and did not enter the dance.
